meta.title: Consuming Darkness – 3
meta.description: Capturing, consuming, eradicating... the collapsed star shall be as a shroud upon the universe.

units.rawText: (Coughs heavily)
units.displayText: Coughs heavily

spans.text: Coughs heavily

units.rawText: The corridors outside the Ops Room for the Titan Base are in ruins. Xinghuan leans against one of the few functioning terminals and watches as Caina stalks toward her, struggling as she tries to get her exo-armor into a fighting stance.
units.displayText: The corridors outside the Ops Room for the Titan Base are in ruins. Xinghuan leans against one of the few functioning terminals and watches as Caina stalks toward her, struggling as she tries to get her exo-armor into a fighting stance.

spans.text: The corridors outside the Ops Room for the Titan Base are in ruins. Xinghuan leans against one of the few functioning terminals and watches as Caina stalks toward her, struggling as she tries to get her exo-armor into a fighting stance.

units.rawText: Damn, even the warning module's broken, huh...
units.displayText: Damn, even the warning module's broken, huh...

spans.text: Damn, even the warning module's broken, huh...

units.rawText: Operands leak from Xinghuan's wounds and stain the entire machine.
units.displayText: Operands leak from Xinghuan's wounds and stain the entire machine.

spans.text: Operands leak from Xinghuan's wounds and stain the entire machine.

units.rawText: Game over.
units.displayText: Game over.

spans.text: Game over.

units.rawText: Caina hefts her longsword and grins sadistically at Xinghuan.
units.displayText: Caina hefts her longsword and grins sadistically at Xinghuan.

spans.text: Caina hefts her longsword and grins sadistically at Xinghuan.

units.rawText: I'm going to make you suffer the most horrible pain imaginable and then I'll crush you to bits.
units.displayText: I'm going to make you suffer the most horrible pain imaginable and then I'll crush you to bits.

spans.text: I'm going to make you suffer the most horrible pain imaginable and then I'll crush you to bits.

units.rawText: As Caina enters the Ops Room, Xinghuan smiles instead.
units.displayText: As Caina enters the Ops Room, Xinghuan smiles instead.

spans.text: As Caina enters the Ops Room, Xinghuan smiles instead.

units.rawText: Operand defensive barrier... ACTIVATE!
units.displayText: Operand defensive barrier... ACTIVATE!

spans.text: Operand defensive barrier... ACTIVATE!

units.rawText: Now reactivating operand defensive barrier...
units.displayText: Now reactivating operand defensive barrier...

spans.text: Now reactivating operand defensive barrier...

units.rawText: ...Are you looking down on me?
units.displayText: ...Are you looking down on me?

spans.text: ...Are you looking down on me?

units.rawText: Furious, Caina swings her longsword around and pulverizes the surrounding machinery.
units.displayText: Furious, Caina swings her longsword around and pulverizes the surrounding machinery.

spans.text: Furious, Caina swings her longsword around and pulverizes the surrounding machinery.

units.rawText: This crappy barrier's almost out of power... and you STILL want to use it to delay me?!
units.displayText: This crappy barrier's almost out of power... and you STILL want to use it to delay me?!

spans.text: This crappy barrier's almost out of power... and you STILL want to use it to delay me?!

units.rawText: I can crack a shitty barrier like this in two or three swings.
units.displayText: I can crack a shitty barrier like this in two or three swings.

spans.text: I can crack a shitty barrier like this in two or three swings.

units.rawText: (Coughs) 98... Even so... I've already achieved my goal.
units.displayText: (Coughs) 98... Even so... I've already achieved my goal.

spans.text: (Coughs) 98... Even so... I've already achieved my goal.

units.rawText: Dammit! What the hell are you counting?
units.displayText: Dammit! What the hell are you counting?

spans.text: Dammit! What the hell are you counting?

units.rawText: Stellar Engine ignition progress 99%... 100%.
units.displayText: Stellar Engine ignition progress 99%... 100%.

spans.text: Stellar Engine ignition progress 99%... 100%.

units.rawText: <size=40>All thrusters fire! Max throttle!</size>
units.displayText: All thrusters fire! Max throttle!

spans.text: All thrusters fire! Max throttle!

units.rawText: <size=40>(Rumble)</size>
units.displayText: (Rumble)

spans.text: (Rumble)

units.rawText: There is a mighty roar, and the entirety of Titan's surface begins shaking.
units.displayText: There is a mighty roar, and the entirety of Titan's surface begins shaking.

spans.text: There is a mighty roar, and the entirety of Titan's surface begins shaking.

units.rawText: What the?!
units.displayText: What the?!

spans.text: What the?!

units.rawText: Stellar Engine ignition complete... Now commencing Phase 1 acceleration...
units.displayText: Stellar Engine ignition complete... Now commencing Phase 1 acceleration...

spans.text: Stellar Engine ignition complete... Now commencing Phase 1 acceleration...

units.rawText: What... What did you just say?!
units.displayText: What... What did you just say?!

spans.text: What... What did you just say?!

units.rawText: Hehe... That's right, my real secret weapon isn't a cannon or a ship or anything.
units.displayText: Hehe... That's right, my real secret weapon isn't a cannon or a ship or anything.

spans.text: Hehe... That's right, my real secret weapon isn't a cannon or a ship or anything.

units.rawText: It's the entire moon you're standing on!  The Stellar Engine will shift Titan's orbit, and it'll smash you to bits along with that entropic comet of yours!
units.displayText: It's the entire moon you're standing on!  The Stellar Engine will shift Titan's orbit, and it'll smash you to bits along with that entropic comet of yours!

spans.text: It's the entire moon you're standing on!  The Stellar Engine will shift Titan's orbit, and it'll smash you to bits along with that entropic comet of yours!

units.rawText: Damn you!
units.displayText: Damn you!

spans.text: Damn you!

units.rawText: Caina rushes toward the control terminal in an attempt to cancel the boost sequences, but before she can reach it, Xinghuan raises the machine gun she's holding with great difficulty and pulls the trigger.
units.displayText: Caina rushes toward the control terminal in an attempt to cancel the boost sequences, but before she can reach it, Xinghuan raises the machine gun she's holding with great difficulty and pulls the trigger.

spans.text: Caina rushes toward the control terminal in an attempt to cancel the boost sequences, but before she can reach it, Xinghuan raises the machine gun she's holding with great difficulty and pulls the trigger.

units.rawText: Bangbangbangbang—
units.displayText: Bangbangbangbang—

spans.text: Bangbangbangbang—

units.rawText: There goes my last mag... Hehe...
units.displayText: There goes my last mag... Hehe...

spans.text: There goes my last mag... Hehe...

units.rawText: Why you!
units.displayText: Why you!

spans.text: Why you!

units.rawText: The program is locked in and the control terminal's destroyed. There's no stopping it now.
units.displayText: The program is locked in and the control terminal's destroyed. There's no stopping it now.

spans.text: The program is locked in and the control terminal's destroyed. There's no stopping it now.

units.rawText: As the Stellar Engine begins shifting Titan, the moon's gravity begins to shift, and Caina's expression grows more and more twisted.
units.displayText: As the Stellar Engine begins shifting Titan, the moon's gravity begins to shift, and Caina's expression grows more and more twisted.

spans.text: As the Stellar Engine begins shifting Titan, the moon's gravity begins to shift, and Caina's expression grows more and more twisted.

units.rawText: You vermin! I'll deal with you later!
units.displayText: You vermin! I'll deal with you later!

spans.text: You vermin! I'll deal with you later!

units.rawText: Don't worry, I'll walk you home gently.
units.displayText: Don't worry, I'll walk you home gently.

spans.text: Don't worry, I'll walk you home gently.

units.rawText: Xinghuan pilots her exo-armor straight into Caina, and the sudden acceleration combined with Titan's gravitational shift leaves the latter unable to block with her sword.
units.displayText: Xinghuan pilots her exo-armor straight into Caina, and the sudden acceleration combined with Titan's gravitational shift leaves the latter unable to block with her sword.

spans.text: Xinghuan pilots her exo-armor straight into Caina, and the sudden acceleration combined with Titan's gravitational shift leaves the latter unable to block with her sword.

units.rawText: Crash—
units.displayText: Crash—

spans.text: Crash—

units.rawText: The ruined exo-armor pins Caina firmly to the wall with its incredible thrust and the crushing weight of Titan's acceleration.
units.displayText: The ruined exo-armor pins Caina firmly to the wall with its incredible thrust and the crushing weight of Titan's acceleration.

spans.text: The ruined exo-armor pins Caina firmly to the wall with its incredible thrust and the crushing weight of Titan's acceleration.

units.rawText: Get off me... <size=40>GET OFF MEEEEEEEEE!</size>
units.displayText: Get off me... GET OFF MEEEEEEEEE!

spans.text: Get off me...
GET OFF MEEEEEEEEE!

units.rawText: However, Xinghuan's exo-armor can't fully immobilize Caina's body. The purple tentacles she extrudes resist the mighty impact and Caina screams as she tries to keep the exo-armor from pinning her down.
units.displayText: However, Xinghuan's exo-armor can't fully immobilize Caina's body. The purple tentacles she extrudes resist the mighty impact and Caina screams as she tries to keep the exo-armor from pinning her down.

spans.text: However, Xinghuan's exo-armor can't fully immobilize Caina's body. The purple tentacles she extrudes resist the mighty impact and Caina screams as she tries to keep the exo-armor from pinning her down.

units.rawText: Ahhhhhhh—
units.displayText: Ahhhhhhh—

spans.text: Ahhhhhhh—

units.rawText: Commencing Phase 3 acceleration... Stellar Engine... operating at maximum power...
units.displayText: Commencing Phase 3 acceleration... Stellar Engine... operating at maximum power...

spans.text: Commencing Phase 3 acceleration... Stellar Engine... operating at maximum power...

units.rawText: Dammit, if you want to die so badly, I'll oblige you!
units.displayText: Dammit, if you want to die so badly, I'll oblige you!

spans.text: Dammit, if you want to die so badly, I'll oblige you!

units.rawText: Caina grabs the ruined arm of the exo-armor and easily rips it off.
units.displayText: Caina grabs the ruined arm of the exo-armor and easily rips it off.

spans.text: Caina grabs the ruined arm of the exo-armor and easily rips it off.

units.rawText: I'll rip you to shreds and then smash that annoying barrier... What are you laughing at?
units.displayText: I'll rip you to shreds and then smash that annoying barrier... What are you laughing at?

spans.text: I'll rip you to shreds and then smash that annoying barrier... What are you laughing at?

units.rawText: System command... 2887!
units.displayText: System command... 2887!

spans.text: System command... 2887!

units.rawText: Xinghuan frees herself of the exo-armor's safety harness, and with a forceful kick of her legs, she launches herself far away from the exo and Caina.
units.displayText: Xinghuan frees herself of the exo-armor's safety harness, and with a forceful kick of her legs, she launches herself far away from the exo and Caina.

spans.text: Xinghuan frees herself of the exo-armor's safety harness, and with a forceful kick of her legs, she launches herself far away from the exo and Caina.

units.rawText:
Oh right, weren't you asking about my name earlier?
I'm the taikonaut <color=orange>Xinghuan!</color>
units.displayText:
Oh right, weren't you asking about my name earlier?
I'm the taikonaut Xinghuan!

spans.text:
Oh right, weren't you asking about my name earlier?
I'm the taikonaut
Xinghuan!

units.rawText: <size=40>NOW GET THE HELL OUT OF MY SECTOR!</size>
units.displayText: NOW GET THE HELL OUT OF MY SECTOR!

spans.text: NOW GET THE HELL OUT OF MY SECTOR!

units.rawText: Kaboom—
units.displayText: Kaboom—

spans.text: Kaboom—

units.rawText: The thrusters of Xinghuan's exo-armor accelerate further, and then the unit itself begins to shine with a blinding light.
units.displayText: The thrusters of Xinghuan's exo-armor accelerate further, and then the unit itself begins to shine with a blinding light.

spans.text: The thrusters of Xinghuan's exo-armor accelerate further, and then the unit itself begins to shine with a blinding light.

units.rawText: <color=red><size=100>AAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHH!</size></color>
units.displayText: AAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHH!

spans.text: AAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHH!

units.rawText: As though it were some kind of chain reaction, the first explosion is soon followed by many more across the surface of Titan.
units.displayText: As though it were some kind of chain reaction, the first explosion is soon followed by many more across the surface of Titan.

spans.text: As though it were some kind of chain reaction, the first explosion is soon followed by many more across the surface of Titan.

units.rawText: The Stellar Engines overload one after another, driving Titan into the ominous purple comet at speeds far in excess of what they were designed for.
units.displayText: The Stellar Engines overload one after another, driving Titan into the ominous purple comet at speeds far in excess of what they were designed for.

spans.text: The Stellar Engines overload one after another, driving Titan into the ominous purple comet at speeds far in excess of what they were designed for.

units.rawText: Exo-armor integrity at 15%... System... Sys%#@m...
units.displayText: Exo-armor integrity at 15%... System... Sys%#@m...

spans.text: Exo-armor integrity at 15%... System... Sys%#@m...

units.rawText: <size=60>Exo-armor, limiter release!</size>
units.displayText: Exo-armor, limiter release!

spans.text: Exo-armor, limiter release!
